newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem $40 mln debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem $40 mln debenture issue.

text.p: Freddie Mac said Wednesday that on March 12 it will redeem the entire $40 million principal amount of its 8.00 percent debenture issues due September 4, 2006.
The debentures, which have cusip number 3134A06Y3, will be redeemed at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount.
Payment of principal plus interest accrued to the redemption date will be made to shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 11, 1997, Freddie Mac said.
Freddie Mac is a corporation chartered by Congress that buys mortgages from lenders and packages them into securities for investors.
